query_normalized: llmxive follow-up: extending "rynnworld-4d: 4d embodied world models for robotic manipulation" computer science
rationale: This paper belongs in the literature review because it directly addresses the core mechanism of "4D Embodied World Models for Robotic Manipulation" by proposing a specific architecture (ABot-M0.5) that solves the alignment challenges in mobile manipulation world models, satisfying criteria (a) for same-mechanism evidence and (d) as a foundational reference for the specific sub-field of world action models in robotics.
